title: Log Duplicate Lens
user: Operators of Loki or JSON log pipelines who need to quantify accidental duplicate ingestion across streams before it distorts search results, alert counts, and storage cost.
smallest_useful_product: A CLI that samples Loki JSON exports or newline-delimited logs, fingerprints messages with configurable timestamp tolerance, groups cross-stream near-duplicates, estimates volume/alert inflation, and emits label/retry evidence.
constraints: Sample and process locally; support redaction before reports; do not infer that identical messages are erroneous without presenting the stream/retry evidence; handle high-cardinality inputs with bounded memory.
